in_sanskrit.name: त्रिलोकेश
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who rules or governs the three worlds of heaven, earth, and netherworld.

in_hindi.name: त्रिलोकेश
in_hindi.long_meaning: The one who is the lord or master of the three worlds.

in_tamil.name: திருலோகேஷ
in_tamil.long_meaning: The one who holds or rules the three worlds of the gods, humans, and demons.

in_telugu.name: తృలోకేశ
in_telugu.long_meaning: The one who rules or holds the three worlds of devas, manavas, and asuras.

in_marathi.name: Trilokesh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the three worlds
in_marathi.long_meaning: Trilokesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Trilokesh is a Sanskrit name that is derived from the words 'tri' meaning three and 'loka' meaning worlds. The name signifies the lord or the ruler of the three worlds: heaven, earth, and the underworld.
